title: OpenAI Plans Desktop ‘Superapp’ to Combine ChatGPT, Codex, Atlas Browser | PCMag
summary: OpenAI plans to merge its popular features into a new desktop service, potentially using ChatGPT as the hub, amidst refocusing on business tools and amidst competition from rivals.
sentiment_reason: The consolidation of tools and refocus on business tools are seen as positive moves for OpenAI, aiming to improve efficiency and quality.
